primary_selection: Prior declared parameter/accuracy balance; frozen before new laboratory outcomes
envelope_other_roles: Same predeclared thresholds for descriptive comparison; widths calibrated from balanced research data only
feasibility: Radial/component existence and approximate wavelength checked with frozen predictions; laser access, signal strength, assignment, cell conditions and lab scheduling require experimental review before outcomes
missing_target_policy: Report all missing targets and any feasibility exclusions, with reason and date; amend a versioned plan before any outcomes rather than silently dropping failed measurements
scoring_basis: Source-supported zero-pressure/unperturbed frequencies. Preserve finite-pressure data and conditions separately; do not fit corrections to validation residuals.
interpretation: Eight chosen P/R pairs share upper rovibrational J. Labeled hyperfine components need not share the same hyperfine eigenstate; component differences do not exactly cancel hyperfine structure.

routine.scope: Descriptive reused interpolation benchmark; no probability or domain-wide accuracy guarantee
routine.recipe: ceil_0.1(maximum_repeat_error + maximum_accepted_start_spread) for balanced future cohort

stress.scope: Contingency from sparse overlapping band/source folds and start sensitivity; no probability or universal high-J guarantee
stress.recipe: ceil_1(maximum_repeat_error + maximum_accepted_start_spread) across balanced future and seven cohorts
